import Mathlib.Data.Finite.Prod
import Mathlib.Data.Fintype.Defs

set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false
set_option maxSynthPendingDepth 3

namespace AbcAdaptation.Reference

/-!
# The large volume container (taxis #43)

The **large volume container** of the Corollary 3.12 variant (taxis #33) is the
project's name for the combination of

1. the combinatorics of processions and capsules with their label sets `S_{j+1}`
   (IUT I, §§4–6; `Iut.Procession`), and
2. the local and global tensor-packets of log-shells
   (IUT III, Propositions 3.1–3.3 and 3.9; Hoshi, *Introduction to inter-universal
   Teichmüller theory (continued)*, §13).

"Large volume container" is project terminology, not the name of a single definition in
IUT III; this module documents exactly how the Lean abstraction corresponds to the
processions, tensor-packets and integral structures of the papers.

## Correspondence with IUT III, Propositions 3.1–3.3

For a capsule `S` of the procession and a rational place `v_Q`, the tensor-packet of
IUT III, Propositions 3.1–3.2 is the tensor product over the labels `j ∈ S` of the
direct sums `⊕_{v ∣ v_Q} log(F_v)` of local fields lying over `v_Q`. Expanding the
tensor product over the direct sums, the packet decomposes as a direct sum indexed by
the **tuples of places** `(v_j)_{j ∈ S}` with `v_j ∣ v_Q`, each summand a tensor
product of local fields presented as a direct sum of fields. Accordingly:

* the component index of the packet presentation at `(i, v_Q)` is *literally* the type
  `(capsule i).LabelType → fiber v_Q` of such tuples (`LargeVolumeContainerData.packet`),
  so the API retains both the `v_Q`-level direct-sum decomposition over `v ∣ v_Q` and
  the procession labels — replacing this by an unindexed product over `v ∈ V` would
  lose data used by the indeterminacies and by the log-volume (taxis #43, #44);
* the mono-analytic log-shell integral structures placed inside the packets
  (IUT III, Proposition 3.2) appear as the regions `logShell`, product regions which
  are relatively compact, agree with the holomorphic integral region at all but
  finitely many `v_Q` (only ramified and archimedean places contribute; cf. IUT I,
  Definition 5.4.5), and contain the holomorphic integral region at nonarchimedean
  places;
* nonarchimedean and archimedean places are treated separately: the index type
  `Iut.RationalPlace` distinguishes them, the containment
  `integral_subset_logShell_nonarch` is imposed only at nonarchimedean places, and the
  archimedean normalization (Hermitian metric, unit ball) is recorded by the
  log-volume interface of taxis #44.

## Honesty boundary

The *construction* of the packet presentations from actual completions of a number
field — direct sums over `v ∣ v_Q`, tensor products over the capsule labels, semisimple
decomposition, and the log-shells themselves via the `p`-adic logarithm — is local-field
infrastructure tracked in taxis #4 (`lana-agents/padic-log-volume`). Here each packet
presentation enters as an explicit structure field; nothing asserts that a theta-pilot
image lies in the container, and no multiradial algorithm is constructed (out of scope
for taxis #43).

## The global container and admissible regions

The global container is the **restricted product** of the packet totals with respect to
the holomorphic integral regions (`LargeVolumeContainerData.Container`), not a naive
infinite product. The class of admissible regions (`AdmissibleRegion`) consists of
families of packet regions equal to the holomorphic integral region for all but
finitely many `v_Q`; direct-product [pre-]regions and Borel regions are distinguished
by the predicates `AdmissibleRegion.IsProductFamily` and `AdmissibleRegion.IsBorelFamily`
(IUT III, Remark 3.9.5(ii)).
-/

open scoped RestrictedProduct

namespace Iut

universe u₁ u₂ v

/-- The data of the **large volume container** (taxis #43): a procession of capsules
with labels in `ι`, a set `V` of places mapped to rational places, and for each capsule
index `i` and rational place `v_Q` a tensor-packet presented as a direct sum of fields
indexed by tuples of places over `v_Q`, with its mono-analytic log-shell region.

See the module docstring for the exact correspondence with IUT III,
Propositions 3.1–3.3, and for the honesty boundary. -/
structure LargeVolumeContainerData (ι : Type u₁) (V : Type u₂) :
    Type (max u₁ u₂ (v + 1)) where
  /-- The procession of capsules; in the intended instantiation, the standard
  procession `Iut.Procession.standard ℓ*` with `ℓ* = (ℓ - 1)/2`. -/
  proc : Procession ι
  /-- The map sending a place `v ∈ V` to the rational place it divides. -/
  toRational : V → RationalPlace
  /-- Finiteness of the fibers `{v ∣ v_Q}` (a finite set for every place of a number
  field), as chosen data. -/
  fiberFintype : ∀ vQ : RationalPlace, Fintype {v : V // toRational v = vQ}
  /-- The tensor-packet at capsule `i` over `v_Q`, presented as a direct sum of fields
  indexed by the tuples of places `(v_j)_{j ∈ S_i}` with `v_j ∣ v_Q`. The component
  index retains the procession labels and the `v_Q`-level place decomposition. -/
  packet : (i : Fin proc.length) → (vQ : RationalPlace) →
    DirectSumPresentation.{max u₂ u₁, v}
      ((proc.capsule i).LabelType → {v : V // toRational v = vQ})
  /-- The mono-analytic log-shell region placed inside the packet
  (IUT III, Proposition 3.2). -/
  logShell : ∀ (i : Fin proc.length) (vQ : RationalPlace), Set (packet i vQ).Total
  /-- Log-shells are direct-product regions: products of the component log-shells. -/
  logShell_isProduct : ∀ i vQ, (packet i vQ).IsProductRegion (logShell i vQ)
  /-- Log-shells are relatively compact (compact subgroup regions at nonarchimedean
  places, bounded balls at archimedean ones). -/
  logShell_relCompact : ∀ i vQ, IsCompact (closure (logShell i vQ))
  /-- The log-shell agrees with the holomorphic integral region at all but finitely
  many rational places: only ramified and archimedean places contribute
  (cf. IUT I, Definition 5.4.5). -/
  logShell_finiteSupport :
    ∀ i, {vQ | logShell i vQ ≠ (packet i vQ).integralRegion}.Finite
  /-- At nonarchimedean places the log-shell contains the holomorphic integral region
  (IUT I, Definition 5.4.5; IUT III, Proposition 1.2). -/
  integral_subset_logShell_nonarch :
    ∀ i (p : Nat.Primes),
      (packet i (.finite p)).integralRegion ⊆ logShell i (.finite p)

namespace LargeVolumeContainerData

variable {ι : Type u₁} {V : Type u₂} (D : LargeVolumeContainerData.{u₁, u₂, v} ι V)

/-- The fiber of `V` over a rational place: the places `v ∣ v_Q`. -/
def Fiber (vQ : RationalPlace) : Type u₂ := {v : V // D.toRational v = vQ}

instance (vQ : RationalPlace) : Fintype (D.Fiber vQ) := D.fiberFintype vQ

/-- The component index of the packet at `(i, v_Q)`: tuples of places over `v_Q`
indexed by the labels of the `i`-th capsule. -/
abbrev Components (i : Fin D.proc.length) (vQ : RationalPlace) : Type max u₁ u₂ :=
  (D.proc.capsule i).LabelType → D.Fiber vQ

noncomputable instance (i : Fin D.proc.length) (vQ : RationalPlace) :
    Fintype (D.Components i vQ) :=
  Fintype.ofFinite _

/-- An **admissible region** of the large volume container at capsule `i`: a family of
packet regions which agrees with the holomorphic integral region at all but finitely
many rational places. The later constructions (log-volume, taxis #44; holomorphic
hull, taxis #45) operate on this class. -/
structure AdmissibleRegion (i : Fin D.proc.length) : Type max u₁ u₂ v where
  /-- The packet region at each rational place. -/
  region : (vQ : RationalPlace) → Set (D.packet i vQ).Total
  /-- Finite support: away from finitely many rational places the region is the
  holomorphic integral region. -/
  finiteSupport : {vQ | region vQ ≠ (D.packet i vQ).integralRegion}.Finite

namespace AdmissibleRegion

variable {D} {i : Fin D.proc.length}

/-- Pointwise containment of admissible regions. -/
instance : LE (D.AdmissibleRegion i) :=
  ⟨fun R S => ∀ vQ, R.region vQ ⊆ S.region vQ⟩

end AdmissibleRegion

/-- The mono-analytic log-shell of the container, as an admissible region: this is the
region in which the images of the pilot objects are compared in IUT III,
Proposition 3.9 and Corollary 3.12. -/
def logShellAdmissible (i : Fin D.proc.length) : D.AdmissibleRegion i where
  region vQ := D.logShell i vQ
  finiteSupport := D.logShell_finiteSupport i

end LargeVolumeContainerData

end Iut

end AbcAdaptation.Reference
payload.natural_language_statement:
**Formal-code readback**

**English**

Let u₁, u₂ and v be universe levels, let ι : Type u₁ and V : Type u₂ be arbitrary types. LargeVolumeContainerData ι V is a type in universe max(u₁,u₂,v+1). An element D consists of the following data and conditions.

First, D.proc is a procession of labels in ι: a natural number n, a capsule Sᵢ for every i : Fin n, and inclusions Sᵢ.labels ⊆ Sⱼ.labels whenever i ≤ j. A capsule is a finite set of elements of ι, and its LabelType is the subtype of labels belonging to that finite set. D.toRational is a function V → RationalPlace. Here RationalPlace has one element finite(p) for each prime natural number p, and an additional element infinite. For every rational place q, D.fiberFintype supplies a finite enumeration of the fiber Fq = {w : V | D.toRational(w) = q}.

For each i : Fin n and each rational place q, put Cᵢq = (Sᵢ.LabelType → Fq). D.packet i q is a DirectSumPresentation on the index type Cᵢq, with summand universe v. This supplies a commutative ring Aᵢq,c with an arbitrary topology and a specified subset Iᵢq,c for every c ∈ Cᵢq. Its total space Tᵢq is the full dependent function space ∏c Aᵢq,c, with the product topology. Its integral region Jᵢq is {x ∈ Tᵢq | ∀c, x(c) ∈ Iᵢq,c}. The definition does not require the specified subsets to be subrings or the ring operations to be continuous.

D.logShell i q is a subset Lᵢq of Tᵢq. For every i and q it is a product region: there exist subsets Uc ⊆ Aᵢq,c, chosen for this i and q, such that Lᵢq = {x | ∀c, x(c) ∈ Uc}. Its closure in Tᵢq is compact. For each fixed i the set {q | Lᵢq ≠ Jᵢq} is finite. For every i and every prime natural number p, Jᵢ,finite(p) ⊆ Lᵢ,finite(p). There is no corresponding containment requirement at infinite. No compatibility of the packets or regions at different indices i is imposed beyond the procession's inclusions of label sets.

For any such D, Fiber(q) is defined to be Fq, a type in universe u₂, and its Fintype instance is exactly the supplied D.fiberFintype q. Components(i,q) abbreviates Cᵢq, a type in universe max(u₁,u₂). A noncomputable instance gives this function type a finite enumeration, using the finiteness of the label subtype and the fiber. Components are label-to-fiber functions, not pairs of a label and a fiber element.

For each i : Fin n, D.AdmissibleRegion i is a type in universe max(u₁,u₂,v). Its elements R are families R.region(q) ⊆ Tᵢq, indexed by all rational places, together with the condition that {q | R.region(q) ≠ Jᵢq} is finite. In this definition, admissibility requires neither product shape, compact closure nor containment of an integral region. The declared LE instance means R ≤ S precisely when, for every q, R.region(q) ⊆ S.region(q). This file supplies this relation, without declaring a partial-order instance. D.logShellAdmissible i is the particular admissible family whose value at q is D.logShell i q, using D.logShell_finiteSupport i for its finite-exception condition.

No inhabitant D is asserted to exist for arbitrary ι and V. Length zero, empty label sets and empty fibers are permitted. The function index type Cᵢq has one element when the label set is empty, even if Fq is empty; it is empty when the label set is nonempty and Fq is empty. In the latter case Tᵢq is an empty-index product, hence has one element, and its integral region is the whole space. Fibers need not be nonempty and D.toRational need not be surjective. Compactness is ordinary compactness of the closure, with no separation axiom assumed. Neither the word 'large' nor the declarations impose a numerical volume condition.

**简体中文**

设 u₁、u₂、v 为宇宙层级，ι : Type u₁ 和 V : Type u₂ 为任意类型。LargeVolumeContainerData ι V 是宇宙 max(u₁,u₂,v+1) 中的类型。其元素 D 由下列数据和条件组成。

首先，D.proc 是 ι 中的标签集递增族：它含有自然数 n、每个 i : Fin n 对应的标签集 Sᵢ，以及对所有 i ≤ j 成立的包含关系 Sᵢ.labels ⊆ Sⱼ.labels。标签集是 ι 的有限子集，其 LabelType 是由属于该有限集的标签组成的子类型。D.toRational 是函数 V → RationalPlace。这里 RationalPlace 对每个素自然数 p 都有元素 finite(p)，另外还有元素 infinite。对每个有理位 q，D.fiberFintype 给出纤维 Fq = {w : V | D.toRational(w) = q} 的有限枚举。

对每个 i : Fin n 和每个有理位 q，令 Cᵢq = (Sᵢ.LabelType → Fq)。D.packet i q 是以 Cᵢq 为指标类型、分量宇宙为 v 的 DirectSumPresentation。它对每个 c ∈ Cᵢq 给出交换环 Aᵢq,c、该环上的任意拓扑和指定子集 Iᵢq,c。其总空间 Tᵢq 是完整的依赖函数空间 ∏c Aᵢq,c，赋予积拓扑。其整区域 Jᵢq 是 {x ∈ Tᵢq | ∀c, x(c) ∈ Iᵢq,c}。定义不要求指定子集是子环，也不要求环运算连续。

D.logShell i q 是 Tᵢq 的子集 Lᵢq。对每个 i 和 q，它都是积区域：存在针对该 i 和 q 选取的子集 Uc ⊆ Aᵢq,c，使得 Lᵢq = {x | ∀c, x(c) ∈ Uc}。它在 Tᵢq 中的闭包紧致。对每个固定的 i，集合 {q | Lᵢq ≠ Jᵢq} 有限。对每个 i 和每个素自然数 p，都有 Jᵢ,finite(p) ⊆ Lᵢ,finite(p)。在 infinite 处没有对应的包含要求。除标签集递增族中标签集的包含关系外，定义没有要求不同指标 i 处的数据或区域相容。

对任意这样的 D，Fiber(q) 定义为 Fq，是宇宙 u₂ 中的类型；其有限枚举类型类实例正是所给的 D.fiberFintype q。Components(i,q) 是 Cᵢq 的缩写，位于宇宙 max(u₁,u₂)。一个不可计算实例利用标签子类型和纤维的有限性，为此函数类型给出有限枚举。这里的分量指标是从标签到纤维元素的函数，而不是标签与纤维元素组成的有序对。

对每个 i : Fin n，D.AdmissibleRegion i 是宇宙 max(u₁,u₂,v) 中的类型。其元素 R 是对所有有理位 q 指定子集 R.region(q) ⊆ Tᵢq 的族，并附带条件：{q | R.region(q) ≠ Jᵢq} 有限。这里的容许性既不要求积形状，也不要求闭包紧致或包含整区域。所声明的小于等于关系实例规定：R ≤ S 当且仅当对每个 q 都有 R.region(q) ⊆ S.region(q)。本文件给出了这个关系，但未声明偏序类型类实例。D.logShellAdmissible i 是取值为 D.logShell i q 的特定容许区域族，其有限例外条件由 D.logShell_finiteSupport i 给出。

这些声明没有断言任意 ι 和 V 都存在这样的 D。长度为零、标签集为空和纤维为空都被允许。标签集为空时，函数指标类型 Cᵢq 恰有一个元素，即使 Fq 为空也是如此；标签集非空而 Fq 为空时，Cᵢq 为空。在后一种情况下，Tᵢq 是空指标积，因而恰有一个元素，整区域为整个总空间。不要求纤维非空，也不要求 D.toRational 为满射。紧致性指闭包的通常紧致性，没有假设任何分离公理。名称中的“大”以及这些声明都没有施加数值性的体积条件。

**日本語**

u₁、u₂、v を宇宙レベルとし、ι : Type u₁ と V : Type u₂ を任意の型とする。LargeVolumeContainerData ι V は宇宙 max(u₁,u₂,v+1) の型である。その要素 D は次のデータと条件からなる。

まず、D.proc は ι のラベル集合の増大列であり、自然数 n、各 i : Fin n に対する有限ラベル集合 Sᵢ、および i ≤ j のときの包含 Sᵢ.labels ⊆ Sⱼ.labels を持つ。Sᵢ.LabelType はその有限集合に属するラベルの部分型である。D.toRational は写像 V → RationalPlace である。RationalPlace は各素数 p に対する要素 finite(p) と、別の要素 infinite からなる。各有理素点 q に対し、D.fiberFintype はファイバー Fq = {w : V | D.toRational(w) = q} の有限列挙を与える。

各 i : Fin n と有理素点 q に対して Cᵢq = (Sᵢ.LabelType → Fq) と置く。D.packet i q は Cᵢq を添字型とし、成分の宇宙レベルを v とする DirectSumPresentation である。これは各 c ∈ Cᵢq に可換環 Aᵢq,c、その上の任意の位相、および指定された部分集合 Iᵢq,c を与える。全空間 Tᵢq は依存関数空間 ∏c Aᵢq,c 全体であり、積位相を備える。整領域 Jᵢq は {x ∈ Tᵢq | ∀c, x(c) ∈ Iᵢq,c} である。指定された部分集合が部分環であることも、環演算が連続であることも要求されない。

D.logShell i q は Tᵢq の部分集合 Lᵢq である。すべての i と q に対し、これは積領域である。すなわち、その i と q に対して部分集合 Uc ⊆ Aᵢq,c が存在し、Lᵢq = {x | ∀c, x(c) ∈ Uc} を満たす。また、その閉包は Tᵢq においてコンパクトである。各 i を固定すると、集合 {q | Lᵢq ≠ Jᵢq} は有限である。すべての i と素数 p に対し、Jᵢ,finite(p) ⊆ Lᵢ,finite(p) が成り立つ。infinite では同様の包含は要求されない。異なる i のデータや領域の間には、ラベル集合の増大列における包含以外の整合条件は課されない。

このような D に対し、Fiber(q) は Fq と定義され、宇宙 u₂ の型である。その有限列挙の型クラスインスタンスは、与えられた D.fiberFintype q そのものである。Components(i,q) は Cᵢq の略記であり、宇宙 max(u₁,u₂) に属する。非計算的なインスタンスが、ラベル部分型とファイバーの有限性を使い、この関数型の有限列挙を与える。成分の添字はラベルからファイバーへの関数であり、ラベルとファイバーの要素の対ではない。

各 i : Fin n に対し、D.AdmissibleRegion i は宇宙 max(u₁,u₂,v) の型である。その要素 R は、すべての有理素点 q に対する部分集合 R.region(q) ⊆ Tᵢq の族と、集合 {q | R.region(q) ≠ Jᵢq} が有限であるという条件からなる。この許容性は、積の形、閉包のコンパクト性、整領域の包含を要求しない。宣言された大小関係のインスタンスでは、R ≤ S は、すべての q について R.region(q) ⊆ S.region(q) が成り立つことを意味する。このファイルはこの関係を与えるが、半順序の型クラスインスタンスは宣言しない。D.logShellAdmissible i は q における値を D.logShell i q とする許容領域の族であり、有限例外条件には D.logShell_finiteSupport i を用いる。

任意の ι と V に対してこのような D が存在するとは主張されていない。長さゼロ、空のラベル集合、空のファイバーが許される。ラベル集合が空なら、Fq が空であっても Cᵢq はただ一つの要素を持つ。ラベル集合が空でなく Fq が空なら、Cᵢq は空である。後者では Tᵢq は空の添字集合上の積であるため一点からなり、整領域は全空間となる。ファイバーの非空性や D.toRational の全射性は要求されない。閉包のコンパクト性には分離公理の仮定はない。名称に含まれる「大きい」という語やこれらの宣言は、数値的な体積条件を課していない。

**Paper source context (English; separate from the formal-code readback)**

**Paper source context.** Mochizuki III describes the local tensor packet as a tensor product, over labels, of direct sums of log-shells at chosen places above a rational place (Introduction, p. 11; Propositions 3.1–3.2, pp. 92–99). Proposition 3.9(iii) (p. 117) permits families with zero local log-volume at all but finitely many rational places and then sums those local volumes. These passages supply the setting for the local packet-index and region-family interface. “Large volume container” is the reference project’s name for its combined interface, not the title of one definition in Mochizuki.

**Implementation scope.** The selected commands provide LargeVolumeContainerData; its rational-place fibers and finite enumerations; the tuple index Components; AdmissibleRegion; pointwise inclusion of such region families; and logShellAdmissible. The data take a supplied chain of finite label sets, an arbitrary type $V$ with a map to rational-place labels and finite fibers, packet presentations indexed by tuples, and supplied log-shell regions. The fields assert that those regions are product regions with compact closure, equal the designated integral regions outside a finite set, and contain the integral region at finite rational places. The family type likewise requires equality with the designated integral region almost everywhere. With the paper’s zero normalization for integral-region volumes, requiring equality to those regions is stronger than merely requiring zero local volume. No equivalence of these conditions is proved here. The component rings remain arbitrary commutative rings with topologies and designated subsets. This interface does not construct completions, tensor decompositions, p-adic logarithms, or a multiradial algorithm. Although the source file also defines a restricted-product Container abbreviation, that abbreviation is not among this unit’s selected commands.

Shinichi Mochizuki, *Inter-universal Teichmüller Theory III: Canonical Splittings of the Log-theta-lattice* (May 2020), Introduction, construction paragraph and both bullets, ending with the name tensor packet; printed/PDF page(s) 11.

> Then, in order to obtain objects that are immune to the various label indeterminacies discussed above, we consider, for each element $*\in\mathbb S_{j+1}^{\pm}$, and for each [say, for simplicity, nonarchimedean] $v_{\mathbb Q}\in\mathbb V_{\mathbb Q}$,
>
> - the direct sum of the log-shells associated to the prime-strip labeled by the given element $*\in\mathbb S_{j+1}^{\pm}$ at the $\underline v\in\underline{\mathbb V}$ that lie over $v_{\mathbb Q}$;
>
> we then form
>
> - the tensor product, over the elements $*\in\mathbb S_{j+1}^{\pm}$, of these direct sums.
